title: Chicken, spelt and charred cabbage pot

grandparents_cupboard.reason: Everything here is a plain whole food or a cupboard staple a grandparent would recognise, including chicken stock, spelt, frozen peas and crème fraîche.

supermarket.reason: Every ingredient, including pearled spelt, pointed cabbage and little gem, is an everyday Tesco item at a normal price.

basic_kitchen.reason: It needs only a wide lidded casserole, a knife and a board, and searing, browning and simmering are within a confident beginner's reach.

works.reason: The quantities suit four: 250g spelt to 900ml stock, simmered covered for 25 minutes, will cook through, and the cabbage steams tender on top.

honest_times.reason: Twenty active minutes covers the light chopping and the searing and browning, and the 25-minute simmer plus 3 minutes for the peas matches the 30 cook minutes.

honest_ingredients.reason: Little gem is a lettuce, and every listed ingredient and seasoning, including lemon and tarragon, is used in the steps with nothing extra added.

seasonal_feel.reason: Charred pointed cabbage wedges are the centrepiece of a light May pot with peas, lettuce and tarragon, which suits mid-spring.

plain_voice.reason: The steps are short, clear British English instructions with no restaurant language or preaching.

hearty_healthy.reason: Chicken, wholegrain spelt and three vegetables make a filling, balanced family dinner.
